name: What is involved in the kitchen cabinet and countertop installation process?
description: The process involves old cabinet removal, installation of new base and upper cabinets, countertop measurement, fabrication, and final installation.

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the kitchen cabinet and countertop installation process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process typically begins with the removal of old cabinets and countertops. Next, new base cabinets are installed, leveled, and secured, followed by the upper cabinets. Once all cabinets are in place, measurements are taken for the new countertops. Countertops are then fabricated off-site and later installed and secured to the cabinets. Final steps include plumbing and electrical connections (if applicable) and any necessary finishing touches like hardware or trim. Throughout, we ensure precision and adherence to local building codes.
